description: Check whether a country or jurisdiction appears on tracked tax and AML blacklists or greylists, including EU Annex I/II, OECD, FATF and selected national lists. Returns list status, dates, legal basis and stated consequences; this is distinct from the separate FATF greylist taxonomy.

jurisdiction.description: Name or ISO alpha-2 code, e.g. "PA".

name: check_tax_blacklists
title: Tax blacklist check
